title: [MD Official] Marvelous Designer 2022 User Conference p01 Part One_MD11 New Features and Steampunk Style Clothing Production
description: Hello everyone, we held the 2022 User Exchange Conference on the afternoon of January 8, 2022. This conference consisted of three main parts: Steampunk costume creation, Substance material texture production (Speaker: Cino), and how to quickly create a coat in MD and subsequently import it into Maya for modification (Speaker: Johnny Xiao). We welcome everyone to join our QQ group (the group number and password will be automatically replied after following the account or sending a private message!).

summary: # Marvelous Designer 2022 User Conference - Part One: New Features and Steampunk Style Clothing Production ## Introduction to Marvelous Designer 11 Features Let me first introduce the new features of Marvelous Designer 11. ### User Interface Changes First of all, in Marvelous Designer 11, the first new feature is the user interface change. In order to help you use Marvelous Designer more freely, we have made some changes to the interface layout. For example, you can arrange your own combinations. On the left side of the user interface, there are two windows: 1. **General Window**: This is our working area. 2. **Store Window**: Integrated into the app, so you don't need to go to the official website to buy. If you have any questions, you can send us a chat. Jimmy is also here today. He will answer your questions in the chat. If you have any other questions, you can ask them in the Q&A section, because we are a bit busy today. ### Main Interface Layout In Marvelous Designer 11, we mainly divide the main interface into the working area window and the side window. These side windows can be arranged randomly. To change the type of the main window, click on the top triangle. In the past, there was a model window in the upper right corner. In the latest version, we have adopted a new setting. Clicking on the title name at the top allows you to change its type. For example, you can change the 2D window to a UV editor or open two 3D windows at the same time. Additionally, the side window can also be switched to a mode. For instance, you can change the material window to a button. ### Window Management In Marvelous Designer 11, you can duplicate all these windows and arrange them freely or in different positions. When duplicating a window, this window will be arranged freely in the form of a button. You can drag this side window and place it into the window of another pop-out window, forming a group. For example, if you turn its type into a button, you can click on the label below to switch between these two windows. If you want to close the 3D window, you can do the same by clicking on the big X in the upper right corner. ## Main Window Functionality In Marvelous Designer 11, the main window can be opened in multiple ways. In the previous version, there was only one 3D window and one 2D window. For users with multiple screens, this may be a bit too large. You can click on the switch in the lower right corner. For example, if you have two windows, you can have one 3D window and one 2D window that you use most often. If you click on three windows, your screen will be divided into two, allowing you to view the 3D window from different angles or look at a UV editor. ### Handling Multiple Windows One thing worth noting is that there is only one 2D window at the same time. If you change the other windows to 2D, they will be exchanged. For example, if you drag the 3D window into any other 3D window, the other window will reflect the changes. The 3D window, when selected, will be linked to the 2D window. This allows you to open up to four working area windows and separate them across another screen. If you need to open another window, you can display it here. There are some other options available, such as opening a 3D window independently. ### Toolbar Customization You can also adjust the toolbars of the working area. For example, the toolbar of 2D can be dragged to the left, top, or bottom of the interface, depending on your preference. In addition, you can fold the 2D or 3D toolbars. This is an overview of some user interface changes. ## Animation Editor Overview Many friends have been asking, "Where did the animation editor go?" In fact, the animation editor has been moved to the left. Here, you can find some of our usual tools, including recording animation. Next to it, there will be our play tools, such as going back to the first frame or last frame, and replaying the animation. The simulation quality corresponds to the quality of the simulation during the recording of the animation. If you choose to complete the animation, the quality of your simulation will be more precise and stable, albeit at the cost of increased memory and CPU usage. ### Simulation Quality Settings There are two settings for simulation quality: 1. **Normal Speed**: This is a preset for simulation, allowing for faster recording. 2. **Complete Animation**: This setting prioritizes quality over speed. You can adjust these settings according to your needs. For example, if you want stability but don’t want the recording to take too long, you can adjust the settings accordingly. ### Animation Editor Features In the animation editor, you can support animations with negative numbers and move sliders to check the animation area. You can manually enter the range of frames you want to view. You can also use the scene time change to slow down the simulation action. The higher the scene time change, the slower the animation will simulate. ### Part-Format Optimization The next new function is called part-format optimization. This function helps maintain wrinkles on clothing during simulation. If you use the brush to adjust clothing, the part-format optimization will help keep the wrinkles in place even during movement. This feature is vital for achieving realistic clothing simulations, allowing for manual adjustments while maintaining the desired look. ## In-App Shopping Feature In Marvelous Designer 11, a built-in shop is now available. You can log in with your official website account. Once logged in, you can browse various products, see their names, prices, and collection numbers. You can add items to your shopping cart or collect them. The store allows you to search for specific clothing items based on gender, age, and style. ## Smart Top Tool The smart top tool allows you to create top faces easily. As you click with your mouse, you can create connections that automatically form a network of tops. ### Final Remarks This concludes our main updates about the smart top and other features of Marvelous Designer 11.
